name: Ram Network Services
summary: Sydney dialup + web dev + networking ISP (Ram Network Services Pty Ltd, 'Ram.Net', 1996); domain later served AlchemyIT (ACN 082 639 969).

events.details: Domain later AlchemyIT. ISP operation (Ram Network Services, renamed AlchemyIT 2004) was absorbed by IntraPower effective 1 Mar 2008; the ram.net parking evidence in the proposal concerns a domain the ISP never used.

refs.label: The real ISP site was ram.net.au: renamed AlchemyIT in 2004, acquired by IntraPower effective 1 Mar 2008; farewell page still up Oct 2008.
ram.net.au 302-redirected by Sep 2009 and a Plesk default page by May 2013.
The brief's ram.net domain was never the ISP's site: US Cingular WAP content by Dec 2003, Sedo-parked (for sale) by Dec 2014 through Dec 2025.
